A Roman copper alloy coin: nummus from the House of Constantine dating AD330-335. Reverse: GLORIA EXERCITVS, Two soldiers stood either side of two standards. Reece period 17. Obverse: Diademed and draped bust right. Obverse inscription: Illegible. Reverse: Two soldiers stood either side of two standards. Reverse inscription: [GLORIA EXERCITVS]. Mint mark: -/-//--P.
